name: Comcast Corporation
blurb: Comcast Corporation is a global media and technology company operating through five segments: Residential Connectivity & Platforms, Business Services Connectivity, Media, Studios, and Theme Parks. It provides broadband, wireless, and video services to residential and business customers, along with content production and theme park operations. With a market cap of about $94.45 billion and revenue of $125.28 billion (TTM), Comcast is a leading player in the telecommunications and media industry.
recent: As of May 6, 2026, CMCSA stock closed at $26.44, near its 52-week low of $25.75, reflecting a 27% decline from its high. The company reported earnings on April 23, 2026, with net income up 19.7% year-over-year. Analysts have a buy rating with a price target of $34.54, suggesting potential upside of over 30%.
